release_scope: non-destructive final-file H3 calibration gate and revision-bound acceptance evidence
changes: Preserved the 4.3.2 dynamic Ref2VA density policy and nine-category animation-art terminology advisory library.

Added a final per-Segment pass that reads back the written H3 file, validates real reference media hashes/signatures, six-field structure, retention relationships, shot cut times, dialogue events, and sound paragraph limits.
Bound COMMITTED H3 artifacts to the final prompt SHA-256 and acceptance receipt; forged PASS reports, stale manifests, and post-validation edits are rejected.
Restored the 132-segment whitebox Previs media as an optional portable reference layer under camera-moves-whitebox-132/.
Normalized the whitebox manifest to package-relative file names and documented that media is camera/Previs reference only, not production identity or final footage.
Extended verify_previs_media.py to validate either the upstream ZIP or an already packaged media directory without requiring author-machine absolute paths.

verification.package_relative_manifest: PASS; no author-machine absolute media paths

known_limits: Whitebox media verifies technical metadata and packaged integrity, not artistic quality or exact reproduction of a future shot.
A previs_id remains a semantic reference; final H3 prompts must expand camera movement into natural language and project-specific parameters.
Generated film, audio and model execution remain outside this package and require separate human media acceptance.
notes: Ref2VA target density is 240 English words per second with a 2,400-word floor target for a simple 10-second segment.
compile_h3 index records format_pass, reference_labels, h3_detail_policy, word count, final prompt SHA-256, and acceptance receipt.
The final-file gate does not prove visual motion, generated audio intelligibility, or model execution; visual_status remains UNVERIFIED.
